## About

Before joining the Complex Systems PhD program, I worked in various roles as a research,
applied, or data scientist. I applied my prior BA and MS education in psychology
to behavioral science questions, conducting work ranging from survey data collection
and analysis to representing people in simulations
using agent based modeling. I became more interested in how to study and evaluate systems
involving people, leading me to the area of complexity science!
